Create a exmaple file from this file, anonimize names:
```yaml
services:
  grup-fruits-secs-codx-junior:
    image: codxjunior/codx-junior:dind
    container_name: grup-fruits-secs-codx-junior
    runtime: sysbox-runc
    privileged: false
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /home/shared/codx-junior:/home/codx-junior/codx-junior
      - /home/shared/codx-junior-cloud/docker/traefik/letsencrypt/acme.json:/codx-junior/traefik/letsencrypt/acme.json
      - "/home/shared/codx-junior-projects/codx-services/customers/Grup Fruits Secs SCCL:/home/codx-junior-projects/Grup Fruits Secs SCCL"
      - /home/shared/codx-junior/codx-junior-installer/codx-junior-dind/entrypoint-wrapper.sh:/usr/local/bin/entrypoint-wrapper.sh
    # DOCKER
      - dind-storage:/var/lib/docker
      - dind-certs-ca:/certs/ca
      - dind-certs-client:/certs/client
    # PPP
      - /dev/ppp:/dev/ppp

    working_dir: /codx-junior
    environment:
      - CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN=grup-fruits-secs.codx-junior.com
      - GITHUB_ADMINS="codx-junior"
      - CODX_JUNIOR_HIDDEN=1
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.rule=Host(`grup-fruits-secs.codx-junior.com`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.tls=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.tls.certresolver=myresolver"
      - "traefik.http.routers.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.service=grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo"

      - "traefik.http.routers.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.middlewares=redirectscheme"
      - "traefik.http.services.grup-fruits-secs-junior-demo.loadbalancer.server.port=80"

    networks:
      - docker_default

volumes:
  dind-storage:
  dind-certs-ca:
  dind-certs-client:

networks:
  docker_default:
    external: true

```
